title: [R3] Double-send race: sendMessage not guarded against concurrent calls
description:
Race condition in sendMessage:
1. User clicks send → textarea cleared, optimistic bubble shown, Message/set in flight
2. User types new message while waiting for response
3. User clicks send again (or presses Enter) → second Message/set sent for the new text
4. Both messages arrive at server

Symptom: User can accidentally send multiple messages by clicking while a previous send is in flight.

Root cause: sendMessage() is not guarded against concurrent calls. The textarea.value check at line 441 only prevents sending when the field is empty at call time, not while a previous send is in flight.

Fix: Add a flag (let inFlight = false; set true before Message/set, false after) and skip sendMessage if inFlight is true. Or disable the send button.
